summary.title: Add Today stats interval
changes: A new 'Today' time interval is added for statistics, showing the current calendar day from midnight until now.
Insulin and Meal stats now default to the 'Today' interval and show the current day's data.
Charts and axis labels show hourly granularity for 'Today' (and Day), and scrolling aligns to hours or midnight.
Averages and totals update from the visible hourly range when viewing 'Today' instead of using daily caches.
